annotations.title: Keep an image for a document

description: Keeps an image and returns its link, to use as or CSS url() in render_pdf, render_template, open_in_editor and update_document — so the document stays small when you read it back. Give one of: image — a picture the person attached in the chat, as your client passes attached files to tools; image_base64 — bytes you have yourself (one you made, a small file you can read: base64 is text you write, so tens of KB). PNG, JPEG, HEIC, GIF, WebP or AVIF; a photo over 10 MB or in HEIC is brought to print size (4096 px on the long side). A picture the person attached that you can see but have no file of: call ask_for_images, which gives them a link to upload it from their device. An image at a public https address needs no upload: use that address. An SVG goes into the HTML as it is. The image lasts 30 days after a document using it last changed.

image.description: A picture the person attached in the chat.

download_url.description: A temporary https address of the file.

image_base64.description: The image's bytes, base64 (a data: URI is taken too).
